summary: Round 2 complete: all requested VM gates passed; changes remain uncommitted.
body:
Changed this round: `crates/engine/src/{lib.rs,interchange.rs,media_pool.rs,scene_interchange_tests.rs}`, `crates/ui-egui/src/{menus.rs,control.rs}`, and `docs/control-protocol.md`. Previous-round changes remain intact.

Public API added:

```rust
fn Services::is_filesystem_backed(&self, path: &str) -> bool;
```

The predicate defaults to false; native `FsServices` returns true. Overlay creation, linking, reopening and export now distinguish storage from export encoding. Custom filesystem-backed services must override this predicate. Virtual overlays retain their placeholder and warning without probing or spawning the renderer. Filesystem overlays render at final quality even with memory-encoded exports.

Control errors preserve `ok:false`, a human-readable `error`, and structured `diagnostics`. Ordinary error shapes remain unchanged.

TDD results—all names prefixed `scene_fix_`:

| Test | Observed red failure → green |
|---|---|
| `control_keeps_diagnostics` | Diagnostics absent → passed, including readable error and `ok:false` assertions |
| `virtual_overlays_stay_placeholder_after_cache_clear` | Renderer spawn error → passed |
| `virtual_overlays_stay_placeholder_for_export` | Renderer spawn error → passed |
| `filesystem_overlays_use_renderer_for_export` | Missing overlay directory with memory export → passed for both export modes |
| `virtual_storage_independent_of_export_encoding` | Missing filesystem warning → passed |

Existing `filesystem_overlays_use_renderer` stayed green. Targeted validation passed all 39 engine scene tests and both scene UI tests. [Red log](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/engine2/fix-round2-red.log) · [Green log](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/engine2/fix-round2-green.log).

Final requested VM gate:

- Clippy, four packages/all targets, `-D warnings`: passed.
- Engine: **670 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored**.
- Automation: **22 passed**.
- CLI: **30 passed**.
- UI `--lib control`: **15 passed**.
- Layers: passed.

[Full gate log](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/engine2/fix-round2-gates.log). Changed Rust files are formatted; `git diff --check` is clean. No local builds/tests, new dependencies, commits or pushes. Coordination task completed and locks released. No remaining blockers; the pending patch has been applied and adapted—do not reapply it.
